summary: Sicilian Mafia boss Salvatore Lo Piccolo, seen as a successor to Bernardo Provenzano, was arrested in Giardinello after evading capture since 1983. Also arrested were Sandro Lo Piccolo, Gaspare Pulizzi and Andrea Adamo, all among Italy's top 30 most wanted. Police fired warning shots; Sandro shouted "I love you dad!" as the arrested men were flown to Palermo during a day of memory.
